summary: Master advanced cost accounting methods with our comprehensive course. Gain essential skills to improve financial decision-making and drive business success.
lede: Advanced costing techniques help finance professionals trace costs and build cost models for pricing, budgeting, and performance decisions. Designed for management accountants, cost accountants, FP&A analysts, finance business partners, and controllers, the course covers activity-based costing, standard-cost variance analysis, and cost-volume-profit and relevant-cost analysis. You’ll use these methods to explain cost deviations, assess product profitability and pricing or make-or-buy decisions, and prepare management reports and KPIs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, review, or act on cost information in planning, pricing, and performance control. It is suitable for people who need practical advanced cost accounting methods they can use in reporting cycles, decision meetings, and operational reviews.
audience: Pricing Manager using contribution margins for commercial
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of basic financial accounting, budgeting, and management reporting. Familiarity with Excel-based calculations is expected, and prior exposure to standard costing or cost centre reporting will help, but no programming is required. The course is set at intermediate to advanced level, so you should already handle financial statements, cost classifications, and routine variance reports in your current role.
